landingPage.heroDescription: A Next.js dashboard with stat cards, interactive charts, a sortable table and a settings page, filled with realistic sample data and no backend to set up.
landingPage.about: Console is an admin and analytics dashboard you can show before your backend exists. Founders can demo a product idea, teams can prototype an internal tool, and developers get a serious-looking operations dashboard to grow into. The overview opens with four stat cards and two interactive charts with tooltips, keyboard inspection and a table view for screen readers. An events page has a sortable table with status chips, and the settings page is clearly read-only. Every number comes from sample JSON files in the project, so swapping in your own data or API is straightforward. It is a TypeScript Next.js app that deploys from GitHub to Hostinger Node.js hosting.

features.title: Stat cards with trends
features.description: Four overview cards show a value and the change against the previous two weeks, three with a 14-day sparkline.

features.title: Interactive charts
features.description: Area and bar charts with tooltips, arrow-key inspection and a table view under each chart.

features.title: Sortable events table
features.description: Sort recent deliveries by six columns, with status chips and a card layout on phones.

features.title: Honest settings page
features.description: A read-only settings page shows workspace and profile fields and says plainly that there is no backend.

features.title: Sample data you can swap
features.description: Every value comes from JSON files in the project, ready to replace with your own data or API.

features.title: Accessible app shell
features.description: Sidebar navigation, a sticky top bar and a keyboard-friendly mobile drawer on every page.
